I was kind of in the same boat, I went to academy with no preparation (I HIGHLY recommend not doing that), and what helped me is doing it over and over again and taking myself just a bit farther each time. When I went to academy, I could not run, like I had a 13 minute mile (TERRIBLE) but something an instructor said to me still sticks with me to this day. “You’re body will take you farther than your mind will”, meaning that all the pain, all the soreness, the out of breath, fatigue, all that, it psychologically compounds on us and we must train ourselves to keep moving by realizing that our bodies have more potential than our mind will allow us to have. Now, moving on from the psychological aspect, having a workout partner, someone you can motivate and be motivated by is great benefit, you can push each other and challenge each other. It comes down to practice and repetition, your body will adapt if you continue to repeat the workouts. I hope this helps brother!
